Name: Boomerang
Desc: Critical hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine, the next shot has +40% increased damage.

Name: Breadbasket
Desc: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +55% (70%) headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 3 (2).

Name: Close & Personal
Desc: Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.

Name: Eyeless
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% (35%) to blinded enemies. After 4 (3) kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Fast Hands
Desc: Critical hits add a stack of 3% (5%) reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

Name: Finisher
Desc: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 30% critical hit chance and 30% critical hit damage for 15s.

Name: First Blood
Desc: If scoped, your first shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. REQUIRES a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

Name: Frenzy
Desc: For every 10 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

Name: Ignited
Desc: Deal +20% weapon damage to burning enemies. After 4 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Killer
Desc: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +70% critical hit damage for 10s.

Name: Lucky Shot
Desc: Magazine capacity is increased by 20%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

Name: Measured
Desc: The top half of the magazine has 20% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -20% rate of fire and 30% total weapon damage.

Name: Naked
Desc: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 5s.

Name: Near Sighted
Desc: Receive +80% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

Name: On Empty
Desc: Reloading from empty grants +30% weapon handling for 10s.

Name: Optimist
Desc: Weapon damage is increased by +3% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine.

Name: Outsider
Desc: After killing an enemy, gain 100% optimal range and +100% accuracy for 10s.

Name: Overflowing
Desc: Every 3 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

Name: Overwhelm
Desc: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +10% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

Name: Perpetuation
Desc: Headshots grant +50% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 20s

Name: Preservation
Desc:
Killing an enemy repairs 10% armor over 5s. 
Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 10%.

Name: Pummel
Desc: 3 consecutive kills refill the magazine and grant +40% weapon damage for 10s.

Name: Pumped Up
Desc: Reloading grants +1% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 25 times.

Name: Ranger
Desc: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 5m you are away from your target.

Name: Reformation
Desc: Headshots grant +30% skill repair for 15s.

Name: Rifleman
Desc: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +10% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 5. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

Name: Sadist

Name: Salvage

Name: Spike

Name: Steady Handed

Name: Strained
Desc: Gain +10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Unhinged
Desc: Grants +18% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

Name: Unwavering
Desc: Swapping to this weapon grants +300% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

Name: Vindictive
Desc: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 15m 15% critical hit chance and 15% critical hit damage for 20s.

Name: Electromagnetic Accelerator
Desc: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

Name: Big Game Hunter
Desc:
When Scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot. 

Headshots grant +6% headshot damage.   Stacks up to 25 times, 

Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. 

Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

Name: Eagle's Strike
Desc:
Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to +30%. 
Headshot kills grant the Tenacity buff for 15s. 
The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots. 

Tenacity: 40%-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires. 
All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100% with 3 kills.

Name: Tenacity
Desc:
40%-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires. 
All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100% with 3 kills.

Name: Adaptive Instincts
Desc:
Hitting 30 headshots grants +20% critical hit chance and +50% critical hit damage for 45s. 

Hitting 65 body shots grants +90% weapon damage for 45s. 

Hitting 20 leg shots grants +150% reload speed for 45s. 

Buffs refresh when out of combat.

Name: Bullet Hell
Desc:
This weapon never needs to be reloaded. 
For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and your allies' reserves.

Name: Plague of the Outcasts
Desc:
Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. 

This stacking up to 50 times. 

Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, all stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

Name: Regicide
Desc: Headshot kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

Name: Liberty or Death
Desc:
Hits grant +2% weapon damage. Stacks up to 30 times. 
Headshots consume all stacks, repairing your shield for 3% per stack.

Name: Geri and Freki
Desc:
On trigger-pull, fire both barrels at once. When fired from the right shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder. 

Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present. 

When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates for 5s. Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

Name: Agonizing Bite
Desc:
Diamondback randomly marks an enemy. 
Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. 
After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5s. 
A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

Name: Binary Trigger
Desc:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. 

If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack. 

At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals +500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

Name: Sandman
Desc: Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies. Cooldown: 15s

Name: Breathe Free
Desc: When moving, gain 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting, up to 32 stacks total. Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 75%. Kills grant +20% movement speed for 10s.

Name: Incessant Chatter
Desc:
When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 20% for each enemy within 15m for the duration of that magazine. 
Max stacks: 5. 
Kills refill 50% of your magazine.

Desc: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge cooldown: 90s

Name: In Sync
Desc:
Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage for 5s.

Using a non-shield skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +15% weapon damage for 5s.

Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

Desc: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19s. Stacks up to 4 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge cooldown: 90s

Desc:
Hitting an enemy grants +20% skill damage for 5s.

Using a non-shield skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +20% weapon damage for 5s.

Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

Name: Septic Shock
Desc:
Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks adds more severe debuffs to the target.

2 = Poison
4 = Disorient
7 = Shock
8 = Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources) Stacks no longer increase.
9 = Reprocs the 20%
Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

Name: Capacitance
Desc:
Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. 

Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. 

After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second. 

For each utility core, gain 7.5% weapon damage.

Name: Payment in Kind
Desc: Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of +2% critical hit damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s. On reload, apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

Name: In Plain Sight
Desc: Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you. Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you amplified by 50%. Headshot kills reset the cooldown of the Decoy skill. This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

Name: Flatline
Desc: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to pulsed enemies. After 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Perfect Flatline
Desc: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to pulsed enemies. After 2 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Disruptor Rounds
Desc:
Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent.
When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect.

1 - 10 Stacks - Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds.
11 - 25 Stacks - Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds.
26 - 49 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds.
50 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets for 5 seconds. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

Name: Full Stop
Desc:
Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20.
Headshots grant 2 stacks.
Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed.

Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

Name: Busy Little Bee
Desc:
Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% weapon damage increase. 

Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapon and will last for 10 seconds.

Name: Doctor Home
Desc:
Shooting an enemy with Doctor Home applies a mark for 5s. 
When killed, Marked targets drop a 10% Armor repair kit at the agent's feets which applies to the whole party when picked up. 
This kit does not give bonus armor.

Name: Perfect Sledgehammer
Desc: Dealing Damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 20% more damage to armor and have -30% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

Name: Sledgehammer
Desc: Dealing Damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 15% more damage to armor and have -20% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

Name: The Trap
Desc:
Tags enemies when in scope (maximum 10). Killing any marked target with a headshot applies 10 second Burn Status Effect and gives a 50% (20% in PVP modes) Speed Movement decrease on all other targets.  

Cooldown is 30 seconds. Killing another enemy with a headshot shortens the cooldown for 10 seconds. Targets are marked after 1 seconds in scope.

Name: Perfectly Determined
Desc: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed critical headshot. While the talent is active, killing an enemy will not retrigger the talent.

Name: Determined
Desc: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed headshot. While the talent is active, killing an enemy will not retrigger the talent.

Name: Actum Est
Desc: Shooting an enemy gives 1 stack, at 100 stacks the next magazine is filled with shock ammo.

Name: Thunder Strike
Desc: Deal 30% extra damage to shocked targets

Name: Perfect Thunder Strike
Desc: Deal 40% extra damage to shocked targets

Name: Ardent
Desc:
Shooting heats the weapon up filling the "heat meter". The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's standard Magazine Size.
When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon will ignite enemies.
When not shooting, the meter constantly depletes. Reloading or swapping to another weapon fully depletes the meter.

Name: Rule Them All
Desc:
When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, 50% of the ammo in their next magazine will apply the same Status Effect to their targets.
This effect can only occur during combat.

Name: Stabilize
Desc:
1% Weapon Accuracy and +1% Weapon Stability per bullet shot, up to +60%.
Stopping shooting will start a timer of 4 seconds, after which the bonuses reset.

Name: Perfect Stabilize
Desc:
1% Weapon Accuracy and +1% Weapon Stability per bullet shot, up to +75%.
Stopping shooting will start a timer of 6 seconds, after which the bonuses reset.

Name: Mosquito Song
Desc:
Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players. 

At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor. 

Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

Editor's note: the "damage to armor" taken debuff works similarly to Sledgehammer, in that it is an amplifier that applies to both armor and armor plating.

Name: Ortiz Assault Interface
Desc:
While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy.
The weapon deals +75% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

Name: Behind You
Desc: Amplifies weapon damage by +15% to enemies that are not targeting you.

Name: Perfectly Behind You
Desc: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.

Name: Capitulate
Desc: Hitting an enemy will apply a stack of –4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting again will reapply stacks.

Name: Perfect Brazen
Desc: Receive +3% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.

Name: Brazen
Desc: Receive +3% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 6 pellets hit.

Name: Unnerve
Desc:
Killing and enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. 

Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. 

Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5. 

All marks on an enemy will disappear 10s after the last one has been applied. Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

Name: Precision Strike
Desc:
Killing enemies beyond 20m builds up stacks. Max 3.
Hitting an enemy within 20m will use all stack to give 20% Amplified Damage to all enemies within 20m for 5s.

Name: Perfect Precision Strike
Desc:
Killing enemies beyond 20m builds up stacks. Max 2.
Hitting an enemy within 20m will use all stack to give 35% Amplified Damage to all enemies within 20m for 5s.

Name: Symbiosis
Desc: While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second. Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

Name: Perfect Pressure Point
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 20% to enemies under Status Effect.

Name: Pressure Point
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 15% to enemies under Status Effect.

Name: Pakhan
Desc: Each kill with this weapon grants a stack of 75% Magazine Size to the next magazine, up to 4 stacks.

Name: Perfect Streamline
Desc: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

Name: Streamline
Desc: Increase Weapon Damage by 42% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

Name: High Priority Target
Desc:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies within the Tier hierarchy:

Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder.
Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator.
Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

Name: Restrained
Desc: The pistol is fully automatic and deals +25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken

Name: Soft Spot
Desc: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 27% Weapon Damage for 15s.

Name: Perfect Soft Spot
Desc: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 32% Weapon Damage for 15s.

Name: Transfusion
Desc:
Hitting headshots builds stacks, up to a max of 8. When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the shot’s damage for each stack.
Healed Allies will receive 200% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10s.
All hits are guaranteed headshots for 8s after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

Name: Autentico
Desc:
+35% Weapon Damage
+100% Accuracy
No Damage Drop Off
These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

Name: Perfect Immobilize
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 25% to ensnared enemies. After 3 kills, applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Immobilize
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 20% to ensnared enemies. After 4 kills, applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

Name: Sport Mode
Desc: +20% Movement Speed. This bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses.

Name: Cover Shooter
Desc:
Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds.

Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration.

The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.
(The WD Stacks can only be made in combat)

Name: Perfect Measured - DO NOT USE REPORT ME!!
Desc: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and 38% total weapon damage.

Name: Perturb
Desc:
While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will prime it.

While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when shooting for 20s.

Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

Name: Faster Than Reloading
Desc:
Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads you Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied.
Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

Name: Back and Forth
Desc:
Swapping to this weapon grants +10% Rate of Fire and +9% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active.Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

Name: Perfect Back and Forth
Desc:
Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active.
Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

Name: Blossom Harvest
Desc: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 3.3% for each 10% combined Armor and Health the enemy has remaining.

Name: Head Scratcher
Desc: Deal 30% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

Name: Perfect Head Scratcher
Desc: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 3 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

Name: Caduceus
Desc: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

Name: Gangland Hit
Desc:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark.

More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4.

This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own.

Name: You Can Look
Desc:
When out of combat, receive 10 stacks (PvP: 5 stacks). This weapon deals +12.5% Amplified Damage (PvP: +12% Amplified Damage) per stack.

...but you can't touch.

1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s (PvP: 8s).

Name: Foam at the Mouth
Desc: After killing an enemy with a headshot, applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit. Amplifies Weapon Damage by 25% against Ensnared enemies.
